comment.text: NHS L215 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Breast carcinoma; Chronic lymphocytic leukemia; Gastric adenocarcinoma. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.
Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting NHS residue L215 have been observed in breast carcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and chronic lymphocytic leukemia. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.

comment.text: NHS L215P is an allele annotation observed in Cancer Hotspots v1 at the L215 hotspot or indel region. This documents recurrence in the source cohorts; allele-specific function, tumor-specific significance, reference-sequence mapping, and clinical actionability require independent review.
